nodes.title: RFC 10024 ECDHE-MLKEM: is PQ key agreement 'solved' for our stack?
nodes.summary: RFC 10024 Proposed Standard Aug 2026 (X25519MLKEM768, SecP256r1MLKEM768, SecP384r1MLKEM1024) MATCH. rustls 0.23.46 aws-lc-rs: X25519MLKEM768 default; SecP384r1MLKEM1024 ABSENT (also on main 0.24.0-dev.2); ring provider no ML-KEM. RUSTSEC-2026-0349 (2026-10-14): rustls clients <0.23.46 could be downgraded to classical via unauthenticated ServerHello group caching, succeeding when the server accepts an X25519-only share instead of HelloRetryRequest. Cloudflare: ~52% of human HTTPS traffic PQ (since Oct 2025) -> ~half of clients still classical. Ubuntu LXD middlebox rollback Mar 2025, restored 2026-07-03.
nodes.overclaim_risk: 'Solved' over-states: requires rustls>=0.23.46, aws-lc-rs, server HRR-to-hybrid policy; no CNSA P-384/ML-KEM-1024 hybrid in rustls; PQ auth unsolved.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Server side commodity hybrid works and >50% clients already offer it.
nodes.verdict: down (derived 'solved' claim to B with carve-outs); RFC fact A
nodes.specifics: RFC10024 PS Aug 2026 -> PROPOSED STANDARD, Aug 2026 [match]; rustls supports all 3 RFC groups -> 2 of 3 (no SecP384r1MLKEM1024) [mismatch]; PQ downgrade-free -> RUSTSEC-2026-0349 fixed only 0.23.46 [new counter]

nodes.title: aws-lc entropy cannot be made deterministic by interposition
nodes.summary: Raw syscall paths MATCH (aws-lc-sys 0.46.0 urandom.c:189; getrandom 0.2.17 SYS_getrandom; 0.3.4 dlsym/static). NEW: aws-lc default entropy = Tree-DRBG seeded by CPU Jitter entropy + RDRAND/RNDR prediction resistance (entropy_sources.c) -> not interceptable by libc override, seccomp or ptrace. Only sound DST path: deterministic test CryptoProvider under sim + canary.

nodes.title: RUSTSEC-2026-0349: rustls client PQ downgrade via cached kx group
nodes.summary: rustls < 0.23.46 clients recorded server-selected group from unauthenticated ServerHello; attacker forces X25519-only shares; classical handshake if server accepts share instead of HRR. Server acceptance test: client lists X25519MLKEM768 but sends only X25519 share -> server MUST HRR to hybrid.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Client-side bug; server can only mitigate.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Our server policy decides whether downgrade succeeds.

seeds.question: Does rustls server (0.23.46/0.24-dev) send HRR to X25519MLKEM768 when client lists it but sends only X25519 share? Build the acceptance test.
seeds.reason: Decides whether RUSTSEC-2026-0349-class downgrades succeed against us

seeds.question: Per-year (2024/2025/2026) memory vs logic share across Envoy/HAProxy/Traefik/Caddy advisories — is the 2026 memory surge C-only?
Equivalent-mutant triage rate in cargo-mutants on httparse/h2: what fraction of 'missed' are equivalent?
Minimal deterministic rustls CryptoProvider for DST (seeded SecureRandom, pure-Rust primitives) — does one exist?

protocol_implications: Report numeric claims as per-year bands with the classifier stated; pooled 2023-26 memory-safety shares hide a 2026 regime shift.
PQ KA acceptance criterion: rustls>=0.23.46 with aws-lc-rs; server HRR-to-hybrid when the client offers hybrid in supported_groups without a key share; record negotiated group per connection.
Mutation gate fails on cargo-mutants exit codes {2,3}; triage equivalent mutants before setting a threshold.
DST: replace the CryptoProvider under simulation; do not rely on getrandom interposition (aws-lc uses jitter+RDRAND).
Gateway-owned pool: recycle backend connections on role DDL (CVE-2026-14666); ban session-level SET (PgDog SET ROLE fix still unmerged; Supavisor detection only in RC).
redb (if chosen): check_integrity detect-only, fail closed; never auto-repair. SQLite: single writer connection avoids WAL-reset trigger; pin >=3.51.3, current 3.54.1.
Cedar claims must say 'verified Lean model + DRT-tested Rust; TCB includes Lean compiler (native_decide) and cvc5 for SymCC'.
self_improvement: Recount traps: gh search label counts include PRs unless is:issue; gh contents API truncates directories at 1000 entries (OSS-Fuzz projects); KEV lags disclosure by months.
Calibration targets should require per-year breakdowns for any pooled rate.
Node examples ('real test gap') need a semantic check, not just existence checks.
